//: What a player using a screen reader needs before they can reach the screen that would let them ask for it. Copied into config/ of a packaged build. The game applies a partial options file and keeps its own default for everything left out, so this is deliberately short: anything that is taste rather than access -- keyboard, braille display, mod list, window size, sound effects -- stays out and stays theirs.
name: USE_LANG

//: The first screen of a first run is a language picker that draws its own window and speaks nothing at all. Answering it here is what stops a new player meeting a silent wall before the layer has even loaded.
name: USE_TILES

//: Tiles and the pixel minimap draw a picture over the text the screen reader takes its output from.
name: PIXEL_MINIMAP

//: An animation redraws the screen over and over, and every redraw is speech starting again from the top; the delay decides how long that goes on.
name: ANIMATION_DELAY

//: Music plays over speech and cannot be talked across. Sound effects are deliberately left at their default: they carry information and do not compete for the same channel.
name: MUSIC_VOLUME
